entities.summary: Hakob Mnatsakani Hakobian was a Soviet Armenian poet. He was regarded as the founder of Armenian proletarian poetry. Awarded with the titles People's Poet of Armenia and People's Poet of Georgia. He was considered the "Armenian Maxim Gorky" by the Bolshevik press.
